title: Absolutely love this app
body: Amazing app! Makes developing new habits exciting and easy. It’s such an easy way to break down and make a list of long term and short term goals. I love how there are so many options and variety of goals and habits to select from and how each one is customized for their specific purpose. Also love the fact that some goals can be reversed so in stead of it being it a good goal, you can reverse it to a bad one.
